Real Betis Balompié, S.A.D., known as Real Betis, is a professional football club based in Seville, Andalusia, Spain. They compete in La Liga, the top flight of Spanish football. Traditionally, Real Betis play home matches at Estadio Benito Villamarín. However, since 2025, the club have played their home games at the 70,000-seat Estadio La Cartuja while awaiting the completion of a €262 million redevelopment of their traditional home.
